House rules. No real names, yours or anyone else's. No Company relay addresses. Do not post twice in a row from the same colony terminal. If you came here because someone stopped writing back, read the pinned threads first, then post. We do not delete.

## HOW TO HELP Keep a log. Date, time, frequency, who was talking and when they stopped. A colony that loses power goes dark all at once. A colony that is told to stop goes quiet one desk at a time, and the last desk is always the one that handles payroll.
Reading this from {colony}? Note when your relay last spoke to anyone off-world. Then check again tomorrow, and the day after.
